config.scope: Full legal five-card board deck for three compatible weighted private pairs in a finite heads-up SB fold/shove and BB fold/call game. No selected boards, limps, non-all-in raises, later-street betting, antes, rake or multiway equilibrium. Fixed finite-fixture accuracy gates are empirical regression requirements, not convergence guarantees for other ranges or stacks.

preparation_budget.scope: Exact unordered five-card boards per compatible private pair; logical counts, not time or memory guarantees.

memory_scope: One complete 3,000-iteration CFR+ prepared solve with diagnostics and JSON serialization. Excludes one-time full-board equity preparation; Python traced allocation peak, not process RSS.
timing_scope: Single measurements, no backend comparison or speedup claim. Preparation enumerates every board once. Prepared solve timings include training, exact production diagnostics and JSON serialization; they exclude preparation. First composed-call elapsed includes preparation and the first 100-iteration vanilla solve.

equity_preparation.scope: Exact unordered five-card boards per compatible private pair; logical counts, not time or memory guarantees.

work_budget.scope: Conservative bookkeeping and generic-CFR/reference diagnostic loop entries for the fixed two-decision tree; source preparation is charged even when an immutable table is reused. Internal ranking instructions and caller progress callbacks are excluded; total rank calls have a separate pre-enumeration cap. Not bytecode, elapsed time, allocated bytes or RSS bounds.

result.scope: Exact full-board equity for a finite heads-up preflop SB fold/shove and BB fold/call action model. Whole-hand net chip transfers including blinds and unmatched refunds. Both starting stacks exceed the big blind. No limps, non-all-in raises, later-street betting, antes, rake or multiway equilibrium.
